name: Hubei Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Energy Group Co., Ltd. is an energy company engaged in the investment, development, and management of various energy sources. Its business includes hydropower, thermal power, nuclear power, new energy generation, natural gas distribution, coal trading, and financial services. The company has established major power energy bases with hydropower in western Hubei and thermal power in eastern Hubei, and is also developing wind and solar power generation.
